title: The Bypass Almanac
logline: A stranded convoy dispatcher seeks a retired gatekeeper's handwritten solar navigation almanac to bypass an extortionate gate tariff, while a salvage factor tries to buy the route to strip forgotten derelicts.

roles.description: Former chief signalman of the dead colonial bypass; lives in a cold habitat module surrounded by obsolete navigational parchment.
Organizes supply runs for independent border habitats; exhausted, counting every liter of reaction mass.
Deals in unrecovered hulls and proprietary wreckage coordinates; charming, clinical, sees dead ships as uncollected dividend payments.
The bureaucratic gate administration that exercises a legal monopoly over system entry lanes.
A decommissioned relay station positioned at the entrance of a dormant solar corona passage.
A free-port orbital platform where independent cargo runners assemble before dangerous transit legs.

public_situation: Cargo freighters face week-long queues and triple transit fees at {role:transit_authority} gates, leaving perishables rotting in holding orbits.
private_truth: {role:retired_gatekeeper} holds forty years of manual solar flare tables that can guide ships through the dormant bypass without paying {role:transit_authority} tolls.

beats.public_change: {role:convoy_dispatcher} announces an open bounty at {role:convoy_haven} for any functional charts of the old corona bypass.

missions.reason: She needs an outside courier to coax the handwritten solar almanac from {role:retired_gatekeeper} before the stranded haulers run out of station maneuvering fuel.
missions.private_fact: Her own transport company is three days from foreclosure by {role:transit_authority} creditors if the cargo is delayed.

beats.public_change: {role:salvage_factor} intercepts telemetry channels, warning that the bypass route is cluttered with uncertified gravitational debris.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to calibrate three antique navigational transmitters along the passage to confirm his calculated solar flare clearance windows still hold true.
missions.private_fact: He fears his eyesight failed him years ago and his manual calculations may send modern hulls directly into solar flares.

beats.public_change: The verified route calculations circulate among dockside brokers, drawing competing bids from the convoy and commercial salvagers.

missions.reason: She urgently needs the verified navigation tables delivered directly to her flagship so forty cargo vessels can make the solar run simultaneously.
missions.private_fact: {role:salvage_factor} has placed a standing bribe at {role:convoy_haven} to intercept the data slate before departure.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the verified bypass calculations. Two buyers and the official authority each offer an exit.

options.label: Upload the almanac to the convoy flagship
Sell exclusive route coordinates to the salvage factor
Hand the almanac to the transit authority for an amnesty bounty

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the verified navigation tables to the convoy dispatcher.
resolutions.summary: Forty freighters navigate the solar bypass safely, breaking {role:transit_authority}'s toll monopoly and reviving trade across independent outposts.

consequences.public_summary: A courier carried the old gatekeeper's lost solar tables and guided forty starving freighters around the toll gate.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the exclusive navigational coordinates to the salvage factor.
resolutions.summary: {role:salvage_factor} stakes proprietary salvage claims across the bypass, stripping valuable wrecks while the stranded convoy is forced to pay ruinous gate tolls.

consequences.public_summary: Pilots say the old bypass charts were sold off to a scrapper who looted the route while freight haulers starved.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot surrenders the almanac to the transit authority, or route verification proves fatal.
resolutions.summary: {role:transit_authority} classifies the bypass as an illegal hazard corridor, installing automated sentry buoys and raising system tariffs even higher.

resolutions.reached_by: The gatekeeper refuses cooperation or the pilot ignores the contract.
resolutions.summary: The handwritten tables remain unverified. {role:convoy_dispatcher}'s shipping fleet defaults on docking mortgages, and the bypass remains lost to history.

loose_threads.detail: The loan collateral on seven convoy freighters lists the exact corporate debt ledger number of {role:salvage_factor}'s brokerage firm.
The leather cover of the navigation almanac bears an official customs seal that was scraped off with a wire brush thirty years ago.
The clearance log at {role:bypass_observatory} shows three site visits signed under the name of an inspector who died before the war.

radio_hooks: Freighters at {role:convoy_haven} sound horns in protest over {role:transit_authority} toll increases.
Old-timers claim the solar corona lane was flown with slide rules before the gate existed.
{role:transit_authority} warns unauthorized navigation through solar corridors carries immediate vessel impoundment.

voice_direction.retired_gatekeeper: Rough, breathy delivery with long reminiscing digressions. Becomes fiercely possessive and hostile whenever digital nav-computers are mentioned.
voice_direction.convoy_dispatcher: Harried, curt sentences delivered at breakneck speed. Sounds like someone calculating fuel burn penalties in her head while speaking.
voice_direction.salvage_factor: Silky, patient, and excessively courteous. Uses bureaucratic euphemisms like 'asset transition' instead of salvage or grave-robbing.
